Hi Elena,

Welcome — glad to get Vireo Labs set up with Redwood. To get the vendor master created and enable PO issuance, we need the following items from your side:

- Legal entity name (as registered) and any DBAs
- US Tax ID / EIN and a completed W-9 (PDF)

- Accounts Payable primary contact (name, email, phone)
- PO acceptance contact (if different from AP)
- Bank details for ACH (bank name, routing, account number) and an ACH authorization form
- Any procurement terms or EDI/portal requirements you have

I attached our onboarding form to this message (Redwood_Onboarding_Form_v3.pdf) to make this easier — fill the form where convenient and attach the requested docs. If you prefer, we can accept a short email with the basic fields and scanned documents.

Next steps from our side once we receive validated docs:
1) Create vendor master and assign vendor ID
2) Confirm PO routing and AP contact in our ERP (Netsys)
3) Issue initial PO(s) after FY approval (anticipated mid-June)

Marissa (cc'd) will own the vendor record entry and tax/ERP mapping. If you can get the W-9 and ACH form by the end of the week, we can target a vendor-activated date next week.

Thanks,
